Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputPassword(password: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.cardID = InputCard.cardID),
		isPasswordValid: Boolean = if InputCard.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else InputCard.password = password 
		endif 
	precondition:
		InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CardIDValidated = true
	postcondition:
		InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = isPasswordValid
}
